about_the_game:
Washout is a single-player first-person horror game where players must escape a flooded maze inspired by the eerie Bathroom Maze aesthetic. As they navigate the twisting, waterlogged corridors, they must avoid contact with a surreal and unsettling enemy — an anomalous Washing Machine whose erratic behavior defies logic.

Each playthrough offers a fresh experience thanks to procedurally generated levels. With visibility severely limited, sound becomes the player's primary tool for orientation and survival. The game’s atmosphere is further amplified by its VHS and found footage visual style — complete with grain, distortion, and analog tape effects that heighten the sense of unease and disorientation.

Key Features

  • Procedural Generation
    Every run features a newly generated maze layout, ensuring unique gameplay experiences.

  • Unconventional Antagonist
    A one-of-a-kind enemy with unpredictable behavior and an unsettling, audio-driven presence.

  • VHS Aesthetic
    Visuals emulate lost footage, using grain, noise, and analog artifacts to create an immersive retro horror vibe.

  • Sound-Based Gameplay
    With sight limited, players rely heavily on sound cues to navigate and survive within the environment.
